## Dropping based on index and KINGDOM/FAMILY

```{python}
idx_to_drop =[21,110,171]

df.drop(labels=idx_to_drop,inplace=True,axis=0)

df = df[(df['rank']!='KINGDOM') & (df['rank']!='FAMILY')]
```

# Checking num of spaces in searched name vs canonicalname
- Keep Salicorniao, Viola,etc. drop the others
```{python}
df['searched_sp'] = df['searchedName'].str.strip().apply(lambda x: len(x.split(' ')))
df['matched_sp'] = df['canonicalName'].str.strip().apply(lambda x: len(x.split(' ')))

unequal = df[df['searched_sp']!=df['matched_sp']]
unequal.head(20)
```

# Checking searchedName with scientificName (use this for test)
- White space cleaning!
- Genus
- And Non genus pass
```{python}
# df['searchedName'] != df['scientificName'].str.apply(lambda x: x.srip.split(' ')[0])

df['first_of_searched'] = df['searchedName'].apply(lambda x: x.strip().split(' ')[0])
df['first_of_binomial'] = df['scientificName'].apply(lambda x: x.strip().split(' ')[0])
df['first_of_canonical'] = df['canonicalName'].apply(lambda x: x.strip().split(' ')[0])
mask1= (df['first_of_searched']!=df['first_of_canonical'])
mask2= (df['first_of_binomial']!=df['first_of_canonical'])
mask3 = (df['rank']=='GENUS')

df[mask1].head(20)

```
